title: Too Expensive
stamp: Premium for the polish. Free for the grind.
next: Next: twenty minutes of free grind.

scenes.text: Yes. It’s too expensive. It’s also brilliant. Both things are true.
So don’t spend it on the heavy lifting. Save it for the refinements, the little touches, the one hard thing that has to be right.
And no, you can’t run unlimited free models either. Unless you have very deep pockets. I don’t.
